intentional_differences_from_vb6.rapidpy: Always performs a verified home-to-top before bridge zero and after the read, on success, error, timeout, and cancellation.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.reason: VB6 homes only when the lift is below half of SampleBottom and defines no safe return after the read. A verified home is the existing limit-switch contract and is labelled a RapidPy safety improvement, not legacy evidence.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.vb6: modSusceptibility.Susceptibility_Measure homes conditionally before zeroing and leaves the rod at the coil.

intentional_differences_from_vb6.rapidpy: Uses the configured SampleTop - SampleBottom height, the same geometry the bracketed SQUID acquisition already uses.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.reason: Per-specimen height probing at pickup is not yet part of the RapidPy changer path; using one consistent configured height avoids mixing geometries between SQUID and bridge positions.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.vb6: modChanger measures processingSample.SampleHeight from the home position after pickup.

intentional_differences_from_vb6.rapidpy: Does not issue the LagTime measurement. Each bridge reply is bounded by susceptibility.response_timeout.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.reason: LagTime sends M at whatever position the lift occupies. The handoff forbids bridge reads at arbitrary positions; the bounded typed transport replaces the timing calibration.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.vb6: frmSusceptibilityMeter.LagTime sends M during holder runs to time the bridge.

intentional_differences_from_vb6.rapidpy: A failed zero, motion mismatch, malformed reply, timeout, or cancellation aborts the step with immutable evidence and never yields a value.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.reason: VB6 returns 0 or -1 on a missing reply, which can enter output as a measurement.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.vb6: frmSusceptibilityMeter.Measure returns -1 on an empty reply; Susceptibility_Measure returns 0 when the bridge is not configured.

intentional_differences_from_vb6.rapidpy: Holder bridge value is staged with the magnetic holder block and installed in one atomic replacement only when both succeed and the evidence file is persisted.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.reason: Prevents a holder susceptibility from a failed holder command from being subtracted from later samples.
intentional_differences_from_vb6.vb6: SampleHolder.Susceptibility is assigned as soon as the holder bridge read returns.

legacy_source_evidence.finding: Target is Int(SCoilPos + SampleHeight / 2); a target on the opposite side of SCoilPos is rejected; sequence is Zero, MotorUpDn_Move at speed index 0, Measure; holder returns the scaled value, samples use Susceptibility_Standardize.
Measure runs Susceptibility_Measure when the step requests it and doUp Or Not doBoth, before PerformStep and Measure_Read.
Zero sends Z, Measure sends M and multiplies the reply by SusceptibilityScaleFactor.
RunSusceSeq is a separate Bartington-standard calibration scan and is not part of ordinary SUSC steps.

open_physical_acceptance_questions: Is the configured SCoilPos centred on the Bartington coil for the production rod, confirmed with the reference standard?
Is SampleTop - SampleBottom an adequate specimen height for the production specimens, or must per-specimen height probing be added before production use?
Is the 150-step lift settle tolerance of MotorSerialClient.updown_move acceptable at the coil, and does speed index 0 avoid rod contact?
Does the configured response_timeout cover the slowest observed bridge M reply without masking a hung bridge?
Does a verified home-to-top after every read leave the rod clear of the coil and the changer in every tested fault case?
What drift between holder and sample bridge reads is acceptable, and how often must the holder be re-measured?
required_live_inputs: susceptibility.enabled with a shared, non-simulated bridge backend
nonzero susceptibility.coil_position whose sample-centre target stays on the coil side
configured lift positions with nonzero SampleTop - SampleBottom
a valid, non-stale accepted holder record carrying susceptibility_raw, timestamp, and evidence identity
summary: Live SUSC acquisition follows the VB6 zero/move/measure/standardize sequence with a verified safe return, atomic holder staging, and indexed immutable evidence. It is software-verified with fakes only; bridge, coil, standard, and mechanical acceptance remain open.
